correctness.rationale: The proof directly derives the exact mass/composition recursions and characterizes the positive fixed point. A strict relative-ratio contraction with compactness proves all interior compositions converge to it. A uniformly bounded logarithmic product yields an invariant graph and exact iterated mass identity, establishing the trichotomy and its quantified double-exponential radial alternatives. The symmetric bounds and local quadratic curvature follow from simplex norm extrema and dominated expansion of the contracting composition iterates. Exact-rational, high-precision and finite numerical checker tests passed; these tests are only supplemental.

value.rationale: The originating paper motivates the exact stable separating curve as difficult, approximating it in dimension two and providing only two sufficient invariant regions for general dimension. The new necessary-and-sufficient classification covers every strictly positive initial state in a whole open parameter chamber, provides a uniformly certified threshold evaluable to any precision, and quantifies the threshold’s balanced and extreme geometry. This is a structurally motivated dynamical basin invariant, not a routine parameter substitution or a known-table recomputation.
